claims.statement: The frontend layout renders SiteHeader with the cached site counts, Dofus menu items and checklist menu items and SiteFooter around every page and puts the top anchor on the body.

nav.ts defines five sections, with Misiones linking to /metalogros, Dofus linking to /guias-dofus, Checklists linking to /checklists, and pages the app does not have yet linking to the legacy Squarespace site through legacyHref, with the same slug except where Torre's page is named differently.

SiteHeader renders the lockup, a dropdown panel for each section that has pages, the search button, the mode switch and the phone menu below 1120px on the server, and MenuPanelPreview shows a static open panel for the catalog.
SiteFooter has Torre, Explorar and Comunidad columns plus a legal band, each link appearing once, without a live state yet.

HeaderIsland opens and closes the menu panels and the phone sheet, opens the search with Ctrl K or slash, and loads the search engine, its results and the guide index with import() the first time the search opens, never on page load.
GET /api/search/guides returns every published guide as a title, slug, achievement and level tuple sorted by title, read as an anonymous visitor with overrideAccess false and draft false.

The search index endpoint reads with req.payload so the index never takes the requester's permissions, caches it under the guide-pages tag, and sends Cache-Control public, max-age=300, stale-while-revalidate=3600.
The search index endpoint gzips the JSON itself when Accept-Encoding allows it, honoring q=0, sends Vary: Accept-Encoding, and reuses the last compressed buffer until the JSON changes.

Search ranking requires every word, ranks names starting with the query first, then word-start matches, then contained matches, breaks ties by length then alphabetically, and shows all up to 50 matches or the best 20 beyond that.
queryKind requires at least two letters or digits before searching, and search-query.ts is small on purpose because it ships in the islands' initial JavaScript.
loadEntries fetches the search index once per page, sharing the promise between the home search and the header dialog, and forgets a failed request so the next use retries.
highlight returns the name in parts with each occurrence of each word marked, compared without accents or case, for rendering as text and mark rather than innerHTML.
The unit test asserts the search arrives by import() when the dialog opens and that the island and the lazy chunk share no string or icon modules.
The guide search index integration test checks that only published guides appear, with their published version, each once and sorted by title.

The header E2E spec covers dropdowns, keyboard navigation, Ctrl K search, the index requested on open, loading and error states, focus return, the opaque header on scroll, axe in both modes, the phone menu, overflow down to 320px and Volver arriba.

No quest or achievement link in the header leaves the app: the Misiones panel has the search button and a single Ver todo link to /metalogros, repeated in the phone sheet, and its section tile has no separate all link.

The search index also carries the achievement pages and metalogros the metalogros index opens, built by achievementSearchRows from that index view, so an achievement in preparation is not searchable; both lists are optional so an older cached response still works.
The search index is cached under both the guide-pages and achievement-pages tags, so saves in quest-guides, achievement-pages and achievement-groups expire it.

siteEntries turns the index into quest entries linking to their guide with level and achievement, achievement entries linking to their page with metalogro and quest count, and metalogro entries linking to /metalogros#anchor with their counts, throwing on a malformed row.

searchSite ranks quests, achievements and metalogros each in its own group and orders groups by best match, with quests, then achievements, metalogros and the menu groups on a tie; heroResults does the same without the menu.
The search status line counts quests, achievements, metalogros and menu matches, and when any group passes 50 it says más de 50 for that group and ends the found part with sigue escribiendo.

Clases and Mazmorras carry soon: true in SECTIONS, which renders them in the header nav as an aria-disabled span with the Próximamente tag and no panel, as a phone sheet tile that does not fold, and as text with the tag in the footer's Explorar column.

The Dofus panel lists the Dofus of the dofus-guides collection in its order; a Dofus without a published guide renders as an aria-disabled egg-soon element with no link and an en preparación note for screen readers.

The header's menu search index includes only sections without soon, the Dofus of the collection that have a link and the checklists that have a link, so Clases, Mazmorras, their classes and dungeons, Dofus in preparation and checklists without a link are never found.
HeaderIsland toggles a panel only from a button.np and folds a phone tile only from a button.stile__b, so the Próximamente items that share those classes open nothing.
The Dofus panel ends with Ver todas las guías de Dofus, linking to the app's /guias-dofus index, and the phone sheet repeats it.
The layout passes the Dofus list from loadDofusNav and the checklists from loadChecklistNav to SiteHeader, which uses them for the Dofus panel, the phone sheet and searchIndex.
Menu panels enter with @starting-style and leave in 150 ms with display held by allow-discrete so the exit is visible, and have no transition under reduced motion.

loadChecklists is one unstable_cache read of the checklists collection under the checklists tag, and loadChecklistNav maps it to menu items that link a published checklist to its page and an in-preparation one to its legacy page when it has one.

The Dofus panel and the phone sheet list the collection's checklists keyed by slug with a Ver todas las checklists link to the checklists index, mark an in-preparation checklist for screen readers or render it as an aria-disabled span without a link, and omit the block when there are no checklists.
